lines.intro: A fizzy squirrel leaps down the old oak, cheeks stuffed with acorns!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the squirrel?

soothe.great: Fae hums a slow, swaying tune. The squirrel's tail stops flicking!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The squirrel peeks out from behind the trunk.
soothe.miss: The squirrel chatters too loudly to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie chases the squirrel round and round the old oak. They're both giggling!
play.good: Maddie bats at a fallen acorn. The squirrel watches, tail twitching.
play.miss: Maddie tries to climb the oak and slides back down. The squirrel chatters.

cast.great: Sue swings her ribbon bobber like a dangling acorn. The squirrel leaps for it!
cast.good: Sue's bobber bobs past. The squirrel tilts its head.
cast.miss: Sue's line snags on the branch. The squirrel snickers.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles pinecones in a high loop. The squirrel's eyes go round. Better than acorns!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The squirrel catches it with both paws.
juggle.miss: A pinecone bonks Jordan's nose. The squirrel chatters with laughter.

lines.snack: Fae shares a handful of sunflower seeds. The squirrel nibbles them one by one.
lines.burst: The squirrel flings a flurry of acorns from the branch!

burstResult.good: Fae catches most of the acorns!
burstResult.miss: Bonk! An acorn bops Fae on the head.

lines.soothed: The squirrel flicks its tail happily. The fizzy spell fizzles away!
lines.rest: Fae is too dizzy from dodging acorns. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away from the oak. The squirrel keeps chattering.
